title: Abba Labba
html:
Abba Labba Warrior

Abba Labba Warriors and Wizards are found in the Storerooms off of The Embercore Path. The Abba Labba wizards cast the Flammable spell which reduces Fire Resistance and then throw fire balls. Each Abba Labba wizard can summon one Candy Golem, which will disappear soon after the wizard is defeated.

They drop lots of candy to fulfill Wally Wanka's quests.

After some time running The Embercore Path, you may begin to run into Uber Abba Labbas, which are the giant sized versions.

Race:: Abba Labba

Class:: Warrior=Melee, Wizard=Mage.
